name: smart-router
description: Routes every subagent to the right model for the task's difficulty, runs independent work in parallel and starts workflows when a job needs one.

mode.title: Routing mode
mode.description: auto: set each subagent's model by difficulty; suggest: only log what it would set; off: do nothing.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Saver, Balanced (these settings as they are), Fast or Max quality: presets for the tier models, opus quota, parallelism, budget bias and audit rate. The pane's chips switch it per session.

lightModel.title: Light model
lightModel.description: Model for light work (search, read, summarise, mechanical edits): an alias, a full id, or inherit (the main model).

standardModel.title: Standard model
standardModel.description: Model for standard work (features with a clear spec, tests, bugs with a repro, module refactors).

deepModel.title: Deep model
deepModel.description: Model for deep work (architecture, security, concurrency and performance root causes, cross-cutting or production changes).

override.title: Replace chosen models
override.description: never: keep a model the caller set, and custom agents' own models; always: route every subagent by difficulty.

protectDeep.title: Protect deep work
protectDeep.description: Never run deep work on a model weaker than the main one.

budgetBias.title: Budget bias (USD)
budgetBias.description: Past this session spend, borderline tasks go one tier down. 0 turns it off.

opusShare.title: Opus quota (%)
opusShare.description: Soft cap on the share of this project's subagent tokens that run on opus-class models: past it, borderline deep work goes to the standard model. 0 turns it off.

auditRate.title: Quality checks (%)
auditRate.description: Share of finished light and standard agents that changed files for which the pane offers a quick review one tier up. 0 turns it off.

useEffort.title: Effort lever
useEffort.description: Run deep but well-scoped tasks (a race, a leak or a slow path in a few files) on the standard model at effort high instead of the deep model. Off: effort is never set.

useModel.title: Ask a small model for borderline tasks
useModel.description: When the local rules are unsure, ask the light model (5 tokens, 4 s timeout, cached).

maxParallel.title: Max parallel agents
maxParallel.description: Most subagents in one parallel batch (1-8).

workflowThreshold.title: Workflow threshold
workflowThreshold.description: Subtasks from which /route offers Run as workflow (a multi-stage pipeline or more than 10 agents also qualify).

prices.title: Price overrides (JSON)
prices.description: Optional: {"<model id part>": {"input": 3, "output": 15}} in USD per million tokens, ahead of the built-in table.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane at start
autoOpen.description: Open the Router pane when a session starts (docked only on wide terminals).

writeFiles.title: Write summary files
writeFiles.description: Keep ~/.claude/claude-mods/smart-router/daily.json and stats.json up to date for other mods.
